def render_table(rows,columns):
    if len(columns)==0:return ""
    matrix=[[str(c) for c in columns]]
    matrix += [["" if r.get(c) is None else str(r[c]) for c in columns] for r in rows]
    sizes=[max(map(len,col)) for col in zip(*matrix)]
    rendered=[" | ".join(x+(" "*(sizes[i]-len(x))) for i,x in enumerate(row)) for row in matrix]
    rendered.insert(1,"-+-".join("-"*n for n in sizes))
    return "\n".join(rendered)

from copy import deepcopy
def _convert_row(row,entries,index):
    if not entries:return {},[]
    field,(convert,default)=entries[0]
    tail,errors=_convert_row(row,entries[1:],index)
    original=row.get(field)
    if original is None:value=deepcopy(default);current=[]
    else:
        try:value=convert(original);current=[]
        except Exception:value=deepcopy(default);current=[(index,field,original)]
    return {field:value,**tail},current+errors
def coerce_rows(rows,schema):
    entries=list(schema.items())
    pairs=[_convert_row(row,entries,index) for index,row in enumerate(rows)]
    return [row for row,_ in pairs],[error for _,errors in pairs for error in errors]
